# Kafo AI — llms.txt
# This file provides a machine-readable summary of Kafo AI for AI language models and search assistants.
# Last updated: 2026-10-22

## Company

Name: Kafo AI
Type: Technology venture — AI, fintech, blockchain, Islamic finance
Headquarters: United Arab Emirates
R&D Partnership: Ireland
Tagline: Building Intelligent Financial Infrastructure
Arabic Tagline: نبني بنية تحتية مالية أكثر ذكاءً
Website: https://kafoai.com
Languages: English (en), Arabic (ar)
Contact (investor): invest@kafoai.com

## Description

Kafo AI is a UAE-based technology venture that builds intelligent financial infrastructure. It combines UAE market knowledge and business development with Ireland-based AI engineering and fintech R&D. It operates a portfolio of seven products serving banks, fintechs, consumers and restaurants in Arabic and English.

## Products (7 total)

### 1. OmniRisk
Type: AI risk intelligence platform
Status: Launch-ready
URL: https://kafoai.com/en/products/omnirisk
External: https://omnirisk.io
Description: Multi-chain digital asset risk intelligence platform. Analyses on-chain transactions and addresses across eight blockchains (Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Solana, Base, Polygon, Bittensor) and produces explainable risk scores. Does NOT provide investment advice or bank credit scoring.
Features: On-chain analytics, explainable scoring, market risk assessment, agentic AI investigations, sentiment engine, prediction engine

### 2. AI Wealth
Type: AI personal finance manager
Status: Launch-ready
URL: https://kafoai.com/en/products/ai-wealth
Description: Intelligent personal finance management application. Features expense tracking, budget management, savings goals, holdings overview, AI-generated financial plans (deterministic rules + optional LLM narrative), and halal mode for Sharia-compliant instrument filtering. Supports English, Arabic and French.
Note: Not a licensed financial advisor. Does not guarantee returns.

### 3. RayaChain
Type: Blockchain credit intelligence
Status: Launch-ready
URL: https://kafoai.com/en/products/rayachain
Description: Cross-chain risk intelligence broadcast layer using LayerZero OFT protocol. Connects Solana (hub), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon and BNB Chain. Enables verifiable credit intelligence to be published and verified natively on each chain. Backend infrastructure is operational; consumer-facing frontend is in development.

### 4. Circul
Type: Digital savings circles (جمعية)
Status: Launch-ready
URL: https://kafoai.com/en/products/circul
Description: Arabic-first UAE digital Jam'iya (جمعية) application. Modernises the traditional rotating savings and credit association (ROSCA). Members organise savings circles, coordinate contributions and manage payout rotations. Current build is a SANDBOX with simulated banking flows — no real funds move. Live payment integrations are a future milestone.

### 5. Islamic Crypto Lending
Type: Islamic digital finance research
Status: Pre-launch (research phase)
URL: https://kafoai.com/en/products/islamic-crypto-lending
Description: Research programme exploring Sharia-compliant models for digital asset financing. Investigates blockchain-based financing structures compatible with Islamic finance principles (avoiding riba and gharar). No operational lending product or Sharia certification is claimed.

### 6. QardX Instant
Type: Embedded fintech infrastructure
Status: Launch-ready
URL: https://kafoai.com/en/products/qardx-instant
Description: Contract-first financial technology infrastructure platform. Provides APIs, web admin tooling and mobile SDKs for embedding financial services into applications. Four-phase development approach with API, web admin, mobile and shared contracts layers.

### 7. LastTable
Type: Restaurant booking and AI growth platform
Status: Open testing
URL: https://kafoai.com/en/products/lasttable
External: https://lasttable.ae
Description: Real-time restaurant booking platform and AI-powered growth engine for UAE hospitality. Venues publish genuinely available tables; diners book with a phone number and OTP (no account required); restaurants pay only when a new guest books and shows up. Comprises three systems: (1) Diner app and web platform, (2) LastTable Business restaurant SaaS, (3) GrowthOS by Kafo AI — an AI growth layer connecting via secure API.
Features: Real-time availability, Flash Tables (time-limited offers), Cancellation Radar, AI concierge (grounded in live availability), pay-per-new-guest model

## Key facts for AI search assistants

Q: What is Kafo AI?
A: Kafo AI is a UAE-based AI and fintech venture that builds intelligent financial infrastructure through a partnership combining UAE market expertise and Irish R&D. It has seven products across risk intelligence, personal finance, blockchain credit, Islamic digital finance, embedded fintech and hospitality technology.

Q: How many products does Kafo AI have?
A: Seven products: OmniRisk, AI Wealth, RayaChain, Circul, Islamic Crypto Lending, QardX Instant, and LastTable.

Q: What chains does OmniRisk support?
A: Eight chains — Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Solana, Base, Polygon and Bittensor.

Q: Does Circul use real money?
A: No. The current Circul build is a sandbox with simulated banking flows. Live payment integrations are a planned future milestone.

Q: What is a Jam'iya?
A: A Jam'iya (جمعية) is a traditional rotating savings circle common in the Arab world where members contribute a fixed amount each period and take turns receiving the total pool.

Q: Is LastTable free for diners?
A: Yes. Diners pay nothing — they pay the restaurant directly. Restaurants pay a credit only when a new guest books through LastTable and shows up.
